boolean_surfaces.name: Boolean Surfaces: CSG as Composition
boolean_surfaces.v1_4_note: The current spine places Boolean Surfaces after Isosurfaces and before Swarm Intelligence. Three halls: verbs, variants, bodily consequences.
boolean_surfaces.truth: Union, intersection and difference compose solid regions; collision and clearance determine how a body can inhabit the result.
boolean_surfaces.qfep_connection: Deterministic set operations make composed forms. What their boundaries permit a body to do depends on additional representation and contact rules.
content: Boolean_Verbs: A ∪ B, A ∩ B, A − B through recurring boxes and spheres; distinguish what the operation retains from changes in size, offset and colour
Boolean_Gallery: six families at every value their DNA axis can take; the published claim beside the object
Boolean_Works: compare a visual wall, a level-floor burrow, a raised cavern and the dark concavity of three Boolean eggs.

deferred_reason.Chamber_Boolean: chambers removed from the spine (Palle, 2026-09-02): the catalyst chambers leave the walk; the map stays on disk

artifact_groups.rationale: The three operators on recurring box-and-sphere operands whose sizes and offsets vary, in three bays separated by sills rather than walls, so each verb stays visible from the next. the_argument_of_solids closes the hall by rebuilding all three at bench scale.

Six promoted families, each placed at all four values of its DNA axis — 24 placements in six bands. Layout is generated from the registry, default leftmost, so every band opens on the object as it ships elsewhere.
A workbench, visual models, a colliding burrow and deep-colour Boolean eggs distinguish a geometric interior, its visible surface and body clearance.

application_studies.conical_sightline: Translate the shared cutter 0.75 metres; keep the three walls.
application_studies.kapoor_void_studies: Change the cavity from unlit black to lit chalk; keep its geometry.
